intuition: For each anchor point, points on the same line share one reduced slope.

brute_force.approach: Choose pairs of points, form each line, and count all points satisfying its equation.

optimal.approach: For each anchor, count gcd-reduced integer slopes and separately count duplicates.

edge_cases: Duplicate points add to every line through their anchor.
Vertical and horizontal slopes need canonical keys.
A single point is trivially collinear.
